title: Code-review seat output (Codex backend)
description: The final message of a Codex-backed code reviewer (round-1 panel, round-2+ cold re-review, cold regression pass). sf-codex renders it to the review-<role>-r<N>.md artifact and enforces the verdict rule (any CRITICAL/HIGH => FAIL).

id.description: Stable id within this review, e.g. SEC-1, PERF-2.

recommendation.description: Concrete change. Empty when no live code can be cited for a fix — then the problem is stated without a prescription.

recommendation_cite.description: The live file:line the recommendation applies to, or null when no live code can be cited.

live_code_verified.description: True only if the reviewer opened the cited code and confirmed it is reached (not commented out, flagged off, or DISABLED).

clean_areas.description: One short line per area checked and found clean.

deferred_to_domain.description: One line each: a finding that belongs to another reviewer on the panel, naming that domain.

probes_suggested.description: Mutation probes the reviewer would have run (exact edit + expected outcome). Never executed by the reviewer.
